When necessary you check, and touch-up, prints. Your experience and skills help you on a daily basis to make additional or changed connections.Your tasks are, amongst others:· Visually checking the PCB with the help of digital instructions and technical drawings· Determining the process, together with manufacturing engineers, for (process) parameters for the series· Identifying deviations from the predetermined standards· Soldering, touch-op and outcoming goods inspectionYou will work with different kind of toolings, such as: soldering iron, hot plates and/or dryers.
